newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: KLM to launch Dutch corporate card.
newsitem.headline: KLM to launch Dutch corporate card.

text.p: KLM said on Wednesday it planned to launch a corporate air travel and credit card programme for Dutch businesses at the end of the year.

It said the programme, comprising a so-called Air Travel Card and a corporate credit card, would enable companies to register and invoice all air travel purchases and expenses centrally as well as giving access to special facilities.
Using the air travel card, tickets may be booked with almost any airline and costs charged direct to the company, KLM said.

The corporate credit card, developed in association with Britain's National Westminster bank, would offer the same facilities as a normal credit card but would also function as a key to client recognition, it said.
"Thanks to chip technology, it will also become possible in the future to use the card as a smart card for electronic ticketing among other things," the airline said.
